name: kookaburra-backend
description: Independent, white-label NestJS backend and REST API for Kookaburra ecommerce

scripts.check: npm run db:generate && npm run db:validate && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:swagger:syntax && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.bootstrap:owner: npm run build && node -r dotenv/config dist/tools/bootstrap-owner.js
scripts.test:api:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs smoke
scripts.test:api:db: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs db
scripts.test:api:visual:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs visual-smoke
scripts.test:api:visual:all: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs visual-db
scripts.test:api:visual:guest: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs visual-guest
scripts.test:api:security: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs security
scripts.media:cleanup: npm run build && node -r dotenv/config dist/tools/media-cleanup.js
scripts.media:renditions: npm run build && node -r dotenv/config dist/tools/media-renditions.js
scripts.media:reconcile: npm run build && node -r dotenv/config dist/tools/media-reconcile.js
scripts.test:api:visual:checkout: npm run build && node scripts/run-api-tests.cjs visual-checkout
